title: Positivity properties of observables in planar maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory
summary: We study positivity properties of exact observables in planar N=4 super Yang-Mills as functions of the 't Hooft coupling. Motivated by analogous results in quantum mechanics, we ask whether such observables admit a once-subtracted dispersion representation in the coupling over a positive spectral measure. Our main result is that this property, also known as the Stieltjes property, holds for a broad class of exact observables. We prove it analytically, through integral representations, for the octagon anomalous dimension, the logarithm of the circular Wilson loop, the Bremsstrahlung function,…
